commit.message:
Create folder for crate `alloc` and move the `alloc` models into it (#1430)

* Place the Rust standard library models by Rust path

No change in meaning: definitions only move.

- `core::alloc` (`Layout`, `GlobalAlloc`) moves from `Core/Ptr.lean` to
  `Core/Alloc.lean`.
- `alloc::*` lives under `Alloc/`: `Alloc` (`Global`), `Boxed`, `Slice`
  (`to_vec`, `into_vec`), `String`, `Vec` and `Vec/IntoIter`. This replaces
  `Std/Alloc.lean`'s contents, `Std/Vec.lean` and `Std/VecIter.lean`.
- The `Box` instances move out of `Core/Cmp`, `Convert`, `Core` and `Ops`
  into `Alloc/Boxed.lean`, so `Core` no longer imports `alloc`.

`ExtractBuiltinLean.ml` is regenerated: only file/line comments change.

* Rename `core.alloc.boxed.CloneBox.clone` to `alloc.boxed.CloneBox.clone`

The `core.` prefix came from the former `namespace core` in `Core/Core.lean`:
the function models `alloc::boxed::{Clone<Box<T>>}::clone`. This changes the
name used in the extracted code.

* Rename `Global` to `alloc.alloc.Global`
